provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench held-out evaluation fixture, authored 2026-10-24 before any training data. Final-model evaluation only; never shown to training-data generation.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt: Modify sections/card-sale-badge.liquid to add a sale badge. Inputs: section.id and section.settings.heading are strings; price_label is a top-level string; product.price is a nonnegative integer and product.compare_at_price null or a positive integer. When compare_at_price is greater than price, emit one span class=badge with text Sale as the first child of the existing section, before the h3. Preserve the section class and data-id, the h3 heading and the p class=price with their text and escaping. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/card-sale-badge.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
